content:
olivia: quick sync — rolling up action items for the pricing/packaging rollout. TL;DR: we need owners for metering adapter changes, quota enforcement edge cases, and a contract language check for negative adjustments. who can own which?

sam: I can take metering adapter changes (ingest + dimensions). Will need a short list of telemetry events we must preserve.

arjun: taking quota enforcement edge cases (grace windows, concurrent reductions). i'll create a tiny spreadsheet. estimate: 2 d for design + 3 d for impl + tests.

kai: @olivia @sam noted on billing side — need to confirm how negative usage (credit corrections) map to invoice lines. also need to know if quota reductions should trigger pro-rated charges or just block requests. cc @maria for contract constraints.

maria: legal can review the proposed wording around credits/offsets. send a snippet and i'll mark required contract clauses. timeline: 48 hrs review once draft provided.

olivia: great. action list so we don't fumble: 1) sam: list telemetry events + example payloads; 2) arjun: quota-edge spreadsheet + blocking/soft-fail modes; 3) kai: billing mapping doc + invoice example; 4) maria: legal language template. can each of you drop a checkbox reply? :white_check_mark:

sam: checkbox — sam taking telemetry. short list coming by EOD. sample event names: usage.increment, usage.adjustment, quota.violation, quota.recover. payload sketch: ```json
{"event":"usage.increment","customer_id":"cust_123","units":42,"model":"gpt-x.large","timestamp":1680000000}
```

arjun: checkbox — i created the sheet and linked in the thread: https://docs.example.com/sheets/q-edge-1892 (perm: internal). rough matrix rows: trigger, behavior (block/soft), rollback, metrics to emit, owner. question: do we prefer blocking at token-level or request-level?

kai: checkbox — billing mapping doc draft here: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/price-mapping. initial decision: negative adjustments become separate invoice lines with memo referencing original invoice id. prefer pro-rated refunds only for reserved capacity changes, not per-request usage. also: confirm with finance before final.

maria: checkbox — i'll draft contract clause. quick note: we need explicit language about provisional credits and final audit window (30 days). also require customers to accept adjustments in the T&Cs.

billing-bot: SYSTEM: Automated test account usage spike detected in staging on 2026-03-16 14:22:01 — spike generation script ID sg-44.

olivia: thanks. follow-ups: sam — please include the event schema and which fields are required vs optional. arjun — add a column in the sheet for rollback playbook (who toggles feature flag). kai — ping finance after your draft. maria — i'll DM you the prior contract template we used in CY2024.

sam: will do. also flagging one technical constraint: the current metering service batches events every 5s. if we need <1s accuracy for quota enforcement we may need a short path (fast-path). noting perf/deploy risk.

arjun: noted — i'll add a 'latency requirement' column. if fast-path is needed, call it out and we can triage scope.

kai: finance pinged — they want an example of how a retroactive credit shows on a customer's invoice. i'll include sample PDF.

maria: once i have the wording i'll add a short checklist of customer notices we must send to be contract-compliant.

olivia: perfect. i'll compile everything into a single PR checklist and post when docs are in. aim for initial RFC by Tue EOD. if anyone can't meet those timelines, shout now. :clock1:

arjun: Tue EOD works for me.

sam: should be fine, barring major blocker.

kai: finance might need one extra day but i'll try for Tue. will call it out in the doc.

maria: 48-72 hrs after draft — probably Wed/Thu. will prioritize.

olivia: cool — thanks all. i'll create the RFC draft once the links land. tagging follow-ups: @sam for telemetry, @arjun for quota sheet, @kai for billing mapping, @maria for legal clause. :rocket:
